originalPrompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished landscape desktop Roblox pet-inventory concept sketch, about 16:9. Fill the image with the actual game screen, no device frame, no browser, no external design-board decorations.
Input image 1 is ONLY a reference for the separate immersive 3D detail card on the right: convincing perspective yaw, visible beveled thickness, floating shadow, mild cyan rim glow, and cursor-responsive parallax. Do not copy its penguin, pet collection, white inventory panel, star levels, XP, weight, egg luck, text, or game mechanics.
Input image 2 is the authoritative reference for this game's identity and content: bold rounded white typography with black outlines, dark blue-grey rounded inventory, cyan outlines, green multipliers, saturated action buttons, and these cute cubic pets. Retain the exact orange Autumn Cat with autumn canopy and leaves, pink Strawberry Cake, Golden Scarlet Mushroom, red Scarlet Mushroom. Use just these FOUR owned pets, no invented extra owned pets. First three equipped with green checks. Clear labels: "Autumn Cat" Rare x1.6; "Strawberry Cake" Uncommon x1.3; "Golden Scarlet Mushroom" Common x1.3; "Scarlet Mushroom" Common x1.15. Long names can wrap neatly. Header "My Pets"; capacity "4 / 60"; "Team 3/3"; "2 Shards". Keep actions "Unequip", "Recycle", "Best", "Power", "Craft" and the red X close button.
REMOVE ENTIRELY the external left navigation with Balls, Pets, Eggs. Do not leave its column or a replacement sidebar. The left side should be available for the new layout. Background is the softly blurred bright green/yellow football Roblox world from image2, subdued behind UI.
The selected Autumn Cat detail card must feel like an actual THICK 3D display panel in screen space, with perspective trapezoid edges showing rotation around the vertical axis, subtle blue sidewall, floating contact shadow, pet art as a separate depth layer in front of the card, gentle specular reflection. This is NOT merely a flat rectangle rotated clockwise. Display its name, "Rare", large recognizable Autumn Cat art, lightning "x1.6", and "Unequip". Keep all stat text legible with only a restrained perspective angle. No new stats. Cursor near the card and one restrained curved movement arrow can suggest interaction.
Keep silhouette, controls and pet artwork readable. Consistent outlines, careful generous gaps, clear visual hierarchy, restrained glow and no messy particles. No added promotional copy or annotations. High-quality graphic/UI concept rendering, retaining the friendly cartoon game identity of image2 rather than photorealism or sci-fi dashboard.
COMPOSITION 01: A genuinely detached floating selected-pet card on the RIGHT, separated from the main inventory by a generous air gap; this is the closest layout fusion to image1. Inventory occupies left 62 percent of the composition and stays front-facing and stable, card about right 25 percent. Title centered above inventory; 4/60 and Team3/3 and Shards aligned over a tidy single row of four small pet cards in a compact but spacious dark grid well. A modest amount of empty storage area below, no fake pet cards. Recycle dark red, Best green, Power gold, Craft blue in a single well-spaced horizontal row below the grid. Selected detail blue-grey and cyan, visibly hovering at 12 to 16 degree yaw toward the inventory, around 3 degree roll; pet appears raised from its backdrop. Unequip red at bottom of the detail card. Both panels have similar overall heights. Tiny "01" in upper left screen corner.

refinementPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise visual refinement.
Create ONE refined full-screen landscape Roblox pet-inventory mockup, same roughly16:9 composition as INPUT1. This is a refinement of chosen concept01, focused SPECIFICALLY ON BUTTON DESIGN.

INPUT1 is the edit target and composition authority: dark blue-grey inventory on LEFT, four owned pet tiles, a truly detached thick perspective 3D Autumn Cat detail card on RIGHT, blurred colorful game behind. Preserve that composition, four pet identities and exact multipliers, cyan rim, thick perspective of the separate right card, pet artwork, generous air gap, and no navigation sidebar.
INPUT2 is the user's cropped button-style reference. INPUT3 is a supporting full-screen reference for the same button family. Transfer their BUTTON design language, not their white window, pet collection, inventory counts, or mechanics. Do not copy penguins or the other game's game data.

PRIMARY EDIT: replace the mundane four equal rectangular footer buttons with playful polished simulator controls closely matching INPUT2:
- At the lower left of the inventory, a much larger dominant lime/yellow-green rounded button, verbatim "Equip Best", strong white heavy rounded text and thick dark petrol outline, solid offset dark extruded underside, tiny upper highlight, shape bulging slightly. It overlaps/protrudes just BELOW the inventory's lower boundary like the reference, with room and no clipping. Its label must be fully readable.
- To its right, a SEPARATE vivid cyan rounded utility capsule with THREE large individually spaced illustrated icons: red recycling/trash bin for "Recycle", yellow lightning for "Power", blue crafting cube/tool for "Craft". These are clickable-looking chunky 3D cartoon icons, not Unicode, not tiny flat symbols. Small white labels "Recycle", "Power", "Craft" directly underneath each icon in the capsule ensure functions are clear. The three icons share one cyan backing, like the trash/arrows/lock strip in INPUT2. Do not add a lock or a new function. Dark petrol outlines and dark offset underside match Equip Best.
- The ownership metrics become a small separate cyan pill strip near the footer's RIGHT end or immediately above that end, showing a rich brown paw icon with "3 / 3" and an orange storage cube with "4 / 60". Do not add green + buttons or purchases. Make room for the whole strip without overlap, card obstruction or clipping. Place "2 Shards" in a small gold rounded badge near the main header. Avoid duplicating the same metric in multiple places: remove original top capacity/team/shards labels if they have moved into these new pills.
- The inventory footer is intentionally a few separate chunky capsules staggered naturally over the bottom border, visually just like the reference. It must have a clear hierarchy and safe gaps. These controls remain entirely on the inventory's LEFT area and must NOT span below the detached card.
- The red close X at top-right of inventory becomes chunkier, slightly jaunty, with visible deep-red underside like INPUT3.
- On the detached RIGHT 3D pet card, preserve the single red "Unequip" action but restyle it as a fat red-to-hot-pink rounded button with the same dark petrol thick contour, deeper red extruded underside, bold white lettering and restrained glossy highlight, matching the reference. No duplicate Unequip button elsewhere.

PET DATA invariants: exactly four inventory cards, no extra pets: Autumn Cat Rare x1.6; Strawberry Cake Uncommon x1.3; Golden Scarlet Mushroom Common x1.3; Scarlet Mushroom Common x1.15. First three have green equipped checks. Orange Autumn Cat keeps cube body, orange autumn tree canopy, leaves and cute eyes. All tile pet art stays the same as INPUT1. Selected card title Autumn Cat, Rare, x1.6. Keep My Pets title. Dark panel remains DARK, not white. No left Balls/Pets/Eggs navigation.
Keep detached right card convincing perspective yaw, visible beveled blue sidewall and cursor near it with subtle curved rotation arrow. No additional floating cards. Restraint in neon; most visual punch should come from chunky shapes, saturated button plates and drawn icons.
This should visibly advance TOWARD INPUT2's playful oversize button style, not look like the old four ordinary rectangular buttons. All text correct, readable and contained, no overlaps. No invented stats, no character levels, no star ratings. A tiny "01B" at upper-left is acceptable; do not keep01 or03 labels. No captions outside the game screen.
